summary: Niu Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release of its unaudited Q1 2026 financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The release highlights revenues of RMB 909.5 million (up 33.4% YoY), a net loss of RMB 93.9 million, and e-scooter sales of 261,624 units. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, analogous to an 8-K Item 2.02 earnings release. There are no special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or shareholder actions. The filing contains no deal structure, premium, or strategic review. What to watch: ongoing operational performance and AI product rollout.
